defs.def: a mistake, especially one that causes problems or affects the result of sth 错误；差错；谬误

ex.s: After months of trial and error he succeeded.
ex.t: 经过数月的反复试验，他成功了。

ex.s: > With encouragement from his friends and parents, Mark built a small bike shelter for his neighbourhood after months of trial and error.
ex.t: 在朋友和父母的鼓励下，马克经过数月的反复试验，为他的社区建了一个小型自行车棚。

ex.s: This effect capitalizes on the fact that when people make errors, those errors aren’t always the same.
ex.t: 这种效应利用了这样一个事实：当人们犯错时，这些错误并不总是相同的。

ex.s: When enough of these errors are averaged together, they cancel each other out, resulting in a more accurate estimate.
ex.t: 当足够多的这类错误被平均在一起时，它们会相互抵消，从而得出更准确的估算。

ex.s: If people are similar and tend to make the same errors, then their errors won’t cancel each other out.
ex.t: 如果人们彼此相似并倾向于犯同样的错误，那么他们的错误就不会相互抵消。

ex.s: If for whatever reasons, people’s errors become correlated or dependent, the accuracy of the estimate will go down.
ex.t: 如果由于某种原因，人们的错误变得相互关联或相互依赖，估算的准确性就会下降。

ex.s: Most frequently, the groups reported that they “shared arguments and reasoned together.” Somehow, these arguments and reasoning resulted in a global reduction in error.
ex.t: 最常见的是，各小组报告说他们“分享论点并一起推理”。不知何故，这些论点和推理使错误总体上减少了。

ex.s: The causes of people’s errors.
ex.t: 人们犯错的原因。

ex.s: This can lead to the kinds of errors no human would make.
ex.t: 这可能导致人类不会犯的那类错误。

ex.s: For some terms, they simply copied out the correct definition; for others, they were asked to first add an error in their description of the term before  correcting the mistake.
ex.t: 对某些术语，他们只是抄写出正确定义；对另一些，则要求他们先在术语描述中加入一个错误，然后再改正。

ex.s: Naturally, you would expect the addition of the errors to have increased unwanted confusion.
ex.t: 自然而言，你可能会以为加入这些错误会增加不必要的混淆。

ex.s: Yet the exact opposite was true: the participants who made deliberate errors learned about twice as much as the people who simply copied out the correct definitions.
ex.t: 然而事实恰恰相反：那些故意犯错的参与者所学到的内容大约是单纯抄写正确定义者的两倍。

ex.s: So a music teacher may find the addition of deliberate errors could help a student remember the right musical notes.
ex.t: 因此，一位音乐老师可能会发现，加入故意的错误有助于学生记住正确的音符。

ex.s: It is encouraging to discover that by readily accepting our errors and wisely placing ourselves in the way of being wrong, we can in fact overcome weaknesses and rise stronger.
ex.t: 令人鼓舞的是，我们发现，通过坦然接受自己的错误并明智地让自己有犯错的可能，我们实际上可以克服弱点并变得更强大。

ex.s: Adding intentional errors facilitates learning.
ex.t: 加入有意的错误有助于学习。

ex.s: Errors contribute to confusion in learning.
ex.t: 错误会导致学习中的混淆。

ex.s: Learners make fewer errors in difficult subjects.
ex.t: 学习者在难度高的科目中犯的错误更少。

ex.s: Errors: Accidental or Intentional
ex.t: 错误：无意还是有意

ex.s: Cockatoos: Quick Error CheckersB.
ex.t: 凤头鹦鹉：快速纠错者B.

ex.s: Subjects who practiced the language moderately beforehand made fewer errors than those who practiced extensively or not at all.
ex.t: 事先适度练习这种语言的人犯的错误比那些大量练习或根本不练习的人少。

ex.s: If you believe you have received the email in error, email the PASS office at  passoffice@umbs. edu..
ex.t: 如果你认为收到邮件有误，请发邮件至passoffice@umbs.edu..

ex.t: 他们发错了邮件B. 他们未能互动合作

ex.s: While rock-climbing, you need to remain very                  so that you won't make any  dangerous errors.
ex.t: 攀岩时你需要保持                  以免犯危险错误。

ex.s: Trial and error leads to the finding of truth.
ex.t: 反复试验（试错）导向真理的发现。

ex.s: Data collected from the device could be used to recognize different participants based on how they typed, with very low error rates.
ex.t: 从设备收集的数据可用于根据打字方式识别不同的参与者，错误率很低。

ex.s: Indeed, they made only half as many errors as those wearing their own clothes on the Stroop Test( one way of measuring attention).
ex.t: 事实上，他们在斯特鲁普测试（一种测量注意力的方法）中犯的错误只有穿自己衣服者的一半。

ex.s: From now on I will only be editing articles for PsyBlog while wearing a white coat to help keep the typing error count low.
ex.t: 从现在起，我将只在穿白大褂时编辑 PsyBlog 的文章，以帮助降低打字错误的数量。

ex.s: But there weren't any errors in my paper.
ex.t: 但我的论文里没有任何错误。

ex.s: When she climbed the bank toward us and shook out her tail, we realized our error: it was a wolf.
ex.t: 当她爬上河岸朝我们走来并抖了抖尾巴时，我们才意识到我们的错误：那是一头狼。

ex.s: And as they won’t be susceptible to human error, they’ll certainly be a lot safer.
ex.t: 而且，既然它们不会受人为错误的影响，肯定会安全得多。

ex.s: Are there any grammar or spelling errors?
ex.t: 有没有语法或拼写错误？

ex.s: Are there any spelling or punctuation errors?
ex.t: 有没有拼写或标点错误？
